name: @acoyfellow/echo
description: Give an agent explicit, revocable access to one live browser tab.

scripts.dev:fresh: pkill -f 'wrangler dev' 2>/dev/null; pkill workerd 2>/dev/null; sleep 1; wrangler dev --port 8870 --inspector-port 0
scripts.typecheck: bun run build:site && svelte-check --tsconfig ./tsconfig.svelte.json && tsc -p tsconfig.worker.json --pretty false && tsc -p tsconfig.client.json --pretty false && tsc -p tsconfig.scripts.json --pretty false && tsc -p tsconfig.tests.json --pretty false
scripts.setup:secret: openssl rand -base64 48 | wrangler secret put ECHO_SIGNING_SECRET
scripts.check: bun run format:check && bun run lint && bun run typecheck && bun test
